A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the thermal resistance of the package can be reduced significantly by 3D integration, but the thermo-mechanical performance of the package is not necessarily improved.
the thermal resistance of 3D stacked packages is significantly higher than for 2D packages and that the thermo-mechanical stress levels in 3D packages are significantly higher than in 2D packages.
the 3D-Wafer-Level-Packaging (WLP) is the preferred 3D packaging approach, since it offers the best thermal and electrical performance and the lowest cost.
The main takeaway from our work is that
3D integration is a very promising technology for the future.
3D-WL is the most promising technology for the next generation of high performance and low power ICs.
